title: Orbital — A pocket observatory
description: An original procedural eight-planet 3D explorer with warm editorial fact cards, orbital paths, camera following, accessible planet navigation, responsive controls, and a readable WebGL fallback.

tests.outcome: Passed; exit code 0. Vite 7.3.6 transformed 7 modules and completed production bundle in 1.28 seconds without writing output.

knownLimitations: No browser or visual checks were performed; localhost browser access is unavailable.
Planet textures, orbital motion, sizes, and distances are explicitly stylized and not scientifically scaled.
WebGL is required for the interactive scene; planet information remains readable when unavailable.
